title: Specification-Guided Synthesis of Deadlock-Free Communication Protocol Refinements with Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2607.27964v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Ensuring behavioural correctness in communication protocols is a central challenge in distributed software systems, as subtle inconsistencies can lead to deadlocks. In such settings, protocol refinement - the safe substitution of a protocol that preserves correctness and compatibility with other components - is essential. Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in code generation and program synthesis, yet lack mechanisms to reliably produce outputs with correct behaviour. Formal specification approaches, such as multiparty session types (MPST), offer rigorous guarantees, including deadlock freedom, but provide limited support for automatically constructing protocol refinements. translated_title: 基于规范引导的大语言模型无死锁通信协议精化综合
translated_abstract: 确保通信协议的行为正确性是分布式软件系统中的一项核心挑战，因为细微的不一致可能导致死锁。在此类场景中，协议精化——即在对协议进行安全替换的同时，保持其正确性并与其他组件兼容——至关重要。大语言模型在代码生成和程序综合方面已展现出强大的能力，但缺乏可靠生成具有正确行为输出的机制。形式化规范方法（如多方会话类型，MPST）能够提供严格的保证（包括无死锁性），但对自动构建协议精化的支持有限。本文提出了Syntropy，一个由MPST规范与大语言模型共同引导的协议精化综合框架。该框架将精化约束直接融入生成过程中，确保所生成的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出Syntropy框架，将多方会话类型（MPST）的精化约束直接融入大语言模型的生成过程，从而自动综合出保证无死锁且行为正确的通信协议精化。
en_tdlr: This paper presents Syntropy, a framework that incorporates multiparty session type (MPST) refinement constraints directly into the LLM generation process to automatically synthesise deadlock-free, behaviourally correct communication protocol refinements.
